nodes.label: AMPM Platform Wireframe Specifications (wireframes.md v0.2)
nodes.rationale: Draft v0.2 of 25 Oct 2026. A wireframe specification, not a visual design: for every screen it fixes purpose, audience, layout regions, content, actions, states and rules, with low-fidelity sketches. Written because BIZ section 6 requires AMPM to review and approve the exact screen structure before development; extends SPEC section 14, SPEC section 2, BIZ sections 6 and 8 and the two Level-1 flowcharts. Visual design (colour, type, spacing, imagery) is left to AMPM per SPEC.

nodes.label: Wireframes assumptions register W-1 to W-15 (section 0)
nodes.rationale: Each assumption was adopted in place of an unanswered audit question; the register records the audit reference, the assumption, AMPM's 25 Oct 2026 decision stamped on it, and what changes if AMPM decides otherwise. apply_decisions.py stamps decisions.json onto this register.

nodes.label: Changes from AMPM's decisions of 25 Oct 2026 (section 0a)
nodes.rationale: Maps each AMPM decision to the screens it changes: Q1 native iOS/Android apps (all CP and TW screens become app screens, offline indicators extend to TW-70 and TW-56); Q13 mobile OTP (new AUTH-06, AUTH-01 staff only); Q3 demo limits and street view; Q2 basic wedding details before payment, card or UPI only; Q5 two equal family representatives; Q7 read-only guest summaries for clients, no guest editing after submission; Q20 live chat (CP-42, TW-98); Q4 no online milestone payments at launch; Q12 TW-97 dropped; Q10 only Super Admin authorises exceptions; Q9 indicative rate ranges, menus grid, street view; Q8/Q17 no automatic deletion, retention proposals in TW-95; Q23 three-month access window and archive on approval.

nodes.label: Open questions for the screen review (section 12)
nodes.rationale: Eleven items with a default each: locked vs hidden modules for subscriber-only accounts (W-1, Q10); mobile grouping of the team workspace (W-2); family members as portal users (CP-21, Q5); readiness visibility to clients (CP-22, CP-23, hidden); vendor contacts after selection (CP-26, CP-27, hidden); guest-facing programme and calendar files (GR-07, CP-23, offered); demo content (DM-01, masked real hotels); booking milestone amounts to the client (CP-09, W-14); identity capture default and purpose text (TW-33, GR-05, off); counts for Viewers (CP-33, numbers only); Finance home (TW-01, dashboard cards rather than a separate workspace).

nodes.label: Coverage of SPEC section 2, BIZ section 6, flowcharts and SPEC section 12 scenarios (section 11)
nodes.rationale: Four tables prove every SPEC section 2 screen-map item, every BIZ section 6 main screen, every flowchart element (audit section 9 reconciliation) and every SPEC section 12 acceptance scenario is exercised by named screens.

nodes.label: Public website (PUB screens, Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: Top navigation Home, How it works, Destinations, Services, About, Contact with a persistent Request a demo call to action. No sign-in link in the main navigation, only a small Client sign-in in footer and header utility area, so the website does not read as an app (WHY section 1). Pages are static renders from CMS content tables (W-4), though AMPM dropped the website editor.

nodes.label: Authentication screens AUTH (sign-in, activation, recovery, OTP)
nodes.rationale: Shared by clients, staff and demo users. No registration screen anywhere: a number or email AMPM has not invited never gets in (WHY section 4). After AMPM's Q13 decision, AUTH-01 email/password/authenticator is for staff only and AUTH-06 mobile OTP serves prospects and clients.

nodes.label: Demo mode (DM)
nodes.rationale: An approved prospect explores the client portal with sample data and limited permissions under a persistent Demo banner naming the expiry date (WHY stage 2, P-7). Rates render as Available on subscription (A-28); anything a demo user creates becomes a Sales lead activity visible only to Sales.

nodes.label: Client portal (CP screens)
nodes.rationale: Five navigation entries Home, Hotels, My Wedding, Approvals, More (W-1). Home differs by account state: subscriber-only shows CP-01 hotel discovery with My Wedding and Approvals locked; engaged shows CP-20 wedding dashboard; closed project shows CP-20 read-only with the CP-41 banner until client_access_until. After Q1 the client portal is a native app.

nodes.label: Client portal: hotel discovery CP-01 to CP-11 (Phase 1)
nodes.rationale: The subscription product: search, destinations, hotel detail with freshness labels, saved hotels and compare, request hotel assistance, enquiry tracking, proposal decisions, subscription and agreements.

nodes.label: Client portal: engaged wedding CP-20 to CP-42 (Phases 2 to 4)
nodes.rationale: Unlocked when a service agreement is accepted and a project created: dashboard, overview, functions, budget, vendors, designs, invitations, guests, menus, approvals, requests, documents, notifications, feedback, closed state, live chat.

nodes.label: Team workspace (TW screens)
nodes.rationale: Desktop and tablet left rail with the nine SPEC section 2.4 areas (Home, Leads and Clients, Hotels, Weddings, Guests, Vendors, Tasks and Operations, Finance and Reports, Settings); mobile bottom tabs Home, Clients, Weddings, Tasks, More (W-2). A rail entry appears only if the user's roles grant a permission in that area; department managers on phones see only their own sections. Project-scoped roles see only assigned weddings.

nodes.label: Guest RSVP portal (GR screens, Phase 3)
nodes.rationale: Mobile-first single-column wizard reached only through a tokenised per-household link; no sign-in, no navigation, language switch, consent notice on the first step, autosave per step (W-6, A-7, P-4). Every screen names the wedding and the responding household so a forwarded link is obviously someone else's; other households and counts are never shown. Prefix GR rather than GP to avoid clashing with the audit's gap identifiers.

nodes.label: Team workspace area: Leads and Clients (TW-1x)
Team workspace area: Hotels (TW-2x)
nodes.rationale: The flowchart's Database is the Hotels area (W-2, W-12); BIZ section 2.A: the hotel database is never public.

nodes.label: Team workspace area: Weddings (TW-3x and TW-4x)
Team workspace area: Tasks and Operations (TW-7x)
Team workspace area: Finance and Reports (TW-8x)
Team workspace area: Settings (TW-9x)
nodes.rationale: Only Super Admin sees Settings in full (permission-matrix section 5.1); Finance sees budget categories in TW-93 and Sales saw TW-97 before it was dropped.

nodes.label: T1 List and filter template
nodes.rationale: Header with title, count and primary action; filter bar with saved filters, status chips and search; data table or card grid; pagination at 50 (W-11); bulk-action bar when rows are selected; side-panel preview on desktop.

nodes.label: T2 Record detail with tabs template
nodes.rationale: Header (name, status chip, key facts, primary actions, overflow menu); tab strip; right side panel for timeline, comments or related records on desktop, stacking below on mobile.

nodes.label: T3 Form or wizard template
nodes.rationale: Single column, grouped sections, inline validation, sticky footer with Save or Next and Cancel; wizards show a step indicator; drafts autosave.

nodes.label: T4 Board template
nodes.rationale: Columns per status with cards; drag to transition only where the transition table allows; list toggle.

nodes.label: T5 Approval detail template
nodes.rationale: Record header with version timeline on the left, preview or line items centre, approval panel and comment thread on the right. Used for proposals, designs, menus, invitations and budget approvals.

nodes.label: T6 Dashboard template
nodes.rationale: Grid of cards: counters with links, next things to do, alerts; a card appears only when the role has the underlying permission.

nodes.label: T7 Thread and timeline template
nodes.rationale: Chronological events and comments with filters (all, internal, client-visible) and a composer at the bottom.

nodes.label: T8 Live console template
nodes.rationale: Full-width, high-contrast, large touch targets, current-time indicator, sync status, minimal chrome; for run-of-show live view, event-day console and readiness board.

nodes.label: Forbidden equals absent (rule for every screen)
nodes.rationale: A record the principal cannot see renders as not found, never as no permission (architecture section 6). Finance, restricted and sensitive regions are omitted from the response model, not greyed out (W-5), so screens cannot leak the existence of hidden data and the client preview proves what clients see.

nodes.label: Freshness label on hotel commercial values
nodes.rationale: Every hotel commercial value carries Verified on <date> by AMPM, Stale, last checked <date>, or Rates on request (SPEC sections 8 and 12). Stale and unverified values never use the word confirmed; stale is set by a job, never by hand; a rate card cannot be verified without a verification record.

nodes.label: Version timeline (shared component)
nodes.rationale: Versions render as a vertical timeline; shared and approved versions are read-only and New version is the only edit path after sharing (SPEC section 12 version lock), so an approval always refers to the exact version and revisions never overwrite it.

nodes.label: Approval panel (shared component)
nodes.rationale: Record name and version, requester, required decisions, decisions so far, Approve, Request revision, Reject, each requiring a comment where the field matrix says so; shows the Recorded on behalf badge when staff recorded the decision (P-9).

nodes.label: Comment thread (shared component)
nodes.rationale: Chronological, with an Internal toggle for staff defaulting on for staff-to-staff threads; internal comments carry an Internal badge and never render for clients (A-20).

nodes.label: Internal badge and internal-only toggle
nodes.rationale: Internal events, notes and comments are badged unmistakably and omitted from client responses; negotiation notes default to internal-only (TW-27) so internal work never leaks into CP-09.

nodes.label: File card and 15-minute signed download links
nodes.rationale: Title, type, version, uploaded by, visibility badge (Internal, Client, Guest, Public); download mints a 15-minute signed link (architecture section 6); share links are never offered.

nodes.label: Status chips with text labels
nodes.rationale: Use the status lists in permission-matrix section 7 and configurable labels in configurations; every chip has a text label, never colour alone (accessibility).

nodes.label: Preview as client
nodes.rationale: Staff screens for hotels, enquiries, proposals and vendors render the real client screen through the client serialiser (the same response model the client receives), so the preview is the only way to see what clients see and proves internal panels never appear (architecture section 6, SPEC section 12).

nodes.label: Recorded on behalf badge (P-9)
nodes.rationale: When staff record a client decision with evidence, the decision shows a Recorded on behalf badge on both client and staff screens, keeping an audit trail of who actually decided.

nodes.label: Offline capability and sync indicator (W-10)
nodes.rationale: Live-operations screens cache data, queue actions when offline and show a sync indicator with the count of queued updates. AMPM's Q1 decision moved offline support to launch and extended it to tasks, department information and arrival lists.

nodes.label: Double-submission guard and draft recovery
nodes.rationale: Every form guards against double submission and recovers a draft after a refresh; errors keep user input and name the field (SPEC section 10). GR-06 submission is idempotent per token and draft version and atomic.

nodes.label: Audit visibility on record screens
nodes.rationale: Staff record screens show Last changed by <name> on <date> and, for SA and PM (a), a History link to the audit log TW-96 filtered to that record; exports and sensitive views are audited.

nodes.label: Responsive behaviour (W-3)
nodes.rationale: Three layouts: 1200 px and above (rail, content, optional side panel), 768 to 1199 px (collapsible rail), below 768 px (bottom tabs, stacked cards, full-width sheets); touch targets 44 px; WCAG 2.1 AA for client and guest portals. AMPM changed Q1 to native apps for client and team, which reuse the mobile layouts as their information architecture; responsive web stays for the public site only.

nodes.label: W-1 Client portal has five navigation entries with locked My Wedding and Approvals
nodes.rationale: Audit CF-2, Q10. The portal flowchart's four tabs omitted Hotels, the Phase 1 product, so Hotels was added and subscriber-only accounts see My Wedding and Approvals locked with an explanation. AMPM 2026-10-25: partly decided; Hotels confirmed, vendor selection locked until appointment, home page gains help and live chat, structure acceptable for first release. Hiding locked entries is a one-line change; dropping Hotels is not possible.

nodes.label: W-2 Team workspace rail of nine areas on desktop, five bottom tabs on mobile
nodes.rationale: Audit CF-3, AM-6. Flowchart's Database is the Hotels area; a rail entry appears only if the user's roles grant a permission there. AMPM 2026-10-25: confirmed; department managers on phones see only their own sections.

nodes.label: W-3 Responsive web with three breakpoints and WCAG 2.1 AA
nodes.rationale: Audit Q1, A-1, T-12. AMPM 2026-10-25: changed to native apps for client and team, responsive web for the public site only; native apps reuse the mobile layouts as their information architecture.

nodes.label: W-4 Public pages rendered statically from CMS content tables, edited in TW-97
nodes.rationale: Audit Q12, A-12. AMPM 2026-10-25: dropped, no website editor; TW-97 is not built.

nodes.label: W-5 Finance regions render only when the response model contains the fields
nodes.rationale: Audit Q4, P-3. A Viewer without can_view_finance sees no budget region and no placeholder. AMPM 2026-10-25: changed; no finance flag, the two representatives have equal rights, what finance the portal shows is to be confirmed.

nodes.label: W-6 Guest portal is a mobile-first wizard with no sign-in
nodes.rationale: Audit Q7, A-7, T-8. Never shows other households or counts. AMPM 2026-10-25: partly decided; per-side links with self-identification, no editing after submission, wizard otherwise stands.

nodes.label: W-7 Sign-in via email and password, authenticator for staff, optional phone OTP for clients
nodes.rationale: Audit Q13, A-13, U-9. No registration screen anywhere. AMPM 2026-10-25: changed; OTP sign-in screens for prospects and clients (AUTH-06).

nodes.label: W-8 Messages and questions delivered as typed Requests, not chat
nodes.rationale: Audit Q20, A-20, U-12. AMPM 2026-10-25: changed; live chat screen added (CP-42, TW-98), tracked requests stay.

nodes.label: W-9 Identity-document upload only when the project enables capture; masked reference for staff
nodes.rationale: Audit Q8, A-8, P-5. Staff see an audited View document action only with the explicit grant. AMPM 2026-10-25: partly decided; no automatic deletion, retention per policy.

nodes.label: W-10 Live-operations screens offline-capable with a sync indicator
nodes.rationale: Audit GP-34, T-11. Originally Phase 4 for TW-73, TW-74, TW-76. AMPM 2026-10-25: changed; offline screens at launch and extended to tasks, department information and arrival lists.

nodes.label: W-11 List screens paginate at 50 rows with server-side filters and bulk actions
nodes.rationale: Audit Q15, A-15; SPEC section 10. AMPM 2026-10-25: not addressed, stands; page size is configuration.

nodes.label: W-12 Flowchart vocabulary mapped to screens
nodes.rationale: Audit CF-8. Questionnaire and Consultation are lead activity types on TW-11; Countdown appears on CP-20 only when the project has dates; Feedback is CP-40; Archive is CP-41 and TW-45; Schedule, calendar is TW-02. AMPM 2026-10-25: not addressed, stands.

nodes.label: W-13 Consent copy and privacy notice are configurable text approved by AMPM
nodes.rationale: Audit Q17, A-17. PUB-06, GR-01 and PUB-08. AMPM 2026-10-25: confirmed; AMPM decides the wording.

nodes.label: W-14 Booking-milestone amounts shown on CP-09 only where the client pays the hotel directly
nodes.rationale: Audit Q4; mirrors the data model note on booking_milestones.amount. AMPM 2026-10-25: still open.

nodes.label: W-15 Plan selection and payment happen on CP-11 after activation; PUB-07 collects a request only
nodes.rationale: Audit Q2, Q3, U-2. Anonymous checkout contradicts WHY section 4. AMPM 2026-10-25: confirmed; purchase after activation with the basic wedding details form first.

nodes.label: PUB-01 Home
nodes.rationale: Positions AMPM and the three service stages and converts visitors to enquiries or demo requests (SPEC 2.1). No hotel names, prices or private data (BIZ 2.A); only media with public rights (GP-20); showcase carousel and destination grid are omitted when nothing is published.

nodes.label: PUB-02 How it works
nodes.rationale: Explains hotel discovery, optional consultancy and complete management as separate stages (SPEC 2.1 critical rule). No prices in code; fee copy comes from the CMS and is approved by AMPM (BIZ rule 8).

nodes.label: PUB-04 Destinations and selected work
nodes.rationale: Builds confidence with approved public examples without exposing the private database: hotels flagged public_showcase show name and hero image only; no rates, rooms, venues, contacts or verification data and no hotel detail page on the public site (GP-20).

nodes.label: PUB-06 Contact, enquiry and demo request
nodes.rationale: Captures a lead with source, consent and context. Email or phone required, not both; duplicates are accepted and flagged to Sales for merging, never refused to the visitor; no account is created here (WHY 4); consent_marketing unchecked by default; low-friction bot check.

nodes.label: PUB-07 Demo and subscription
nodes.rationale: Explains demo access, plan inclusions, fee and terms and collects a request only; purchase happens in CP-11 after AMPM activates the account (W-15, U-2). Prices come from the plans table, never from code (SPEC 10).

nodes.label: PUB-08 Privacy notice and terms
nodes.rationale: Versioned legal pages; the version shown at consent time is recorded on leads.consent_at and guest consent (GP-40).

nodes.label: PUB-09 Enquiry submitted
nodes.rationale: Shows no data the visitor entered beyond their first name.

nodes.label: AUTH-01 Sign in
nodes.rationale: Generic invalid-credentials message, no hint which part failed, no registration link and no indication whether an email exists. After Q13 this screen (email, password, authenticator code) is for staff only.

nodes.label: AUTH-02 Account activation
nodes.rationale: Turns a single-use 7-day invitation token into an active login; after Q13 activation ends in OTP sign-in for clients.

nodes.label: AUTH-03 Password reset
nodes.rationale: Neutral confirmation regardless of whether the email exists; 1-hour token; resets revoke other sessions; staff only after Q13.

nodes.label: AUTH-04 Access help
nodes.rationale: The flowchart's Contact AMPM for access help: a minimal form that creates a Sales task, creates no account and reveals nothing about existing accounts.

nodes.label: AUTH-05 Authenticator enrolment (staff)
nodes.rationale: Mandatory second factor before first staff use (A-13); cannot be skipped; recovery codes shown once and stored hashed.

nodes.label: AUTH-06 Mobile OTP sign-in (prospects and clients)
nodes.rationale: Added for AMPM's Q13 decision: mobile number with country code (default +91), six-digit code with 10-minute single-use expiry, resend after countdown, remember this device, consent on first sign-in. No registration: a number AMPM has not invited or authorised never gets in; an unknown number gets a neutral message and a lead activity if it matches a lead. Codes go by SMS with WhatsApp fallback (T-6 changed).

nodes.label: DM-01 Demo banner and landing
nodes.rationale: Persistent banner naming the expiry date with Talk to AMPM (creates a demo lead activity). Rates render as Available on subscription (A-28); any enquiry becomes a lead activity, not an enquiry (P-7); nothing a demo user creates is visible beyond Sales; demo data resets on schedule. After Q3: up to three locations, one or two hotels each, indicative price ranges, street view, Request a Zoom call, expiry date.

nodes.label: CP-01 Subscriber home
nodes.rationale: Entry point for a subscriber: search, saved hotels, enquiries in progress, subscription card, and a card explaining the locked My Wedding and Approvals entries. Expired or suspended accounts see saved hotel names only with a renew prompt; never shows counts about other clients.

nodes.label: CP-04 Hotel search results
nodes.rationale: Filterable results with a freshness label on every card and a compare tray of up to four. Inactive hotels never appear; demo users see only demo_visible hotels; the word confirmed is never used for rates (SPEC 12 freshness test).

nodes.label: CP-05 Hotel detail
nodes.rationale: Everything a subscriber may know about a hotel with the verification date of every commercial fact. No hotel contacts, internal rating, internal notes or source of rates; stale or unverified never reads as confirmed; demo amounts replaced by Available on subscription. After Q9: Rates tab shows indicative ranges with verified date and a package range, a Menus tab with the food grid, a street view panel.

nodes.label: CP-06 Saved hotels and compare
nodes.rationale: Shortlist plus side-by-side comparison of up to four; unique per account and hotel, a project back-fills project_id later (GP-27). After Q9 titled My selection with Check availability per hotel, which creates an enquiry.

nodes.label: CP-07 Request hotel assistance
nodes.rationale: Four-step wizard creating one enquiry per selected hotel. Services are labelled Included in your plan or May be chargeable, AMPM will confirm (U-3); fees are never quoted here (BIZ rule 8, Q4) because chargeable services are confirmed by a service agreement that appears later in CP-09.

nodes.label: CP-09 Enquiry detail
nodes.rationale: The client's view of one enquiry with internal work excluded (SPEC 12 negotiation test): notes_internal, internal-only events, outcome_internal and internal_total_amount are absent from the response, not hidden (architecture 6). Milestone amounts only where W-14 applies.

nodes.label: CP-10 Hotel proposal detail and decision
nodes.rationale: Review a negotiated offer and Accept, Request revision or Decline against the exact shared version (SPEC 12 version lock); internal amounts absent; expired validity disables the decision; a staff-recorded decision shows the Recorded on behalf badge (P-9).

nodes.label: CP-11 Subscription, plans and agreements
nodes.rationale: Buy or renew the subscription, accept service agreements and pay milestones. Prices and terms come from plans and service_agreements, never from code; no purchase before AMPM has activated the account (WHY 4). After Q2 a first step Your wedding collects couple's names, contact, tentative dates and preferred locations, and the client-side bank-transfer path is removed (card or UPI only).

nodes.label: CP-20 Wedding dashboard
nodes.rationale: One screen with dates, milestones, pending decisions, permitted budget summary and upcoming tasks. Finance card absent without the flag (W-5, contents to confirm after Q4); countdown only when dates exist (W-12); no readiness, internal cost or staff notes; gains a chat entry after Q20.

nodes.label: CP-21 Wedding overview and contacts
nodes.rationale: Facts of the wedding and who is who; external venue contacts and staff notes absent. After Q5 shows the two family representatives with their side and drops Request access for a family member.

nodes.label: CP-22 Functions list
nodes.rationale: Readiness status and internal notes absent; cancelled functions shown struck through.

nodes.label: CP-23 Function workspace
nodes.rationale: One function's shared plan; run-of-show, production items, artist fees and staffing are absent.

nodes.label: CP-24 Budget
nodes.rationale: Client-facing budget showing only approved client-facing fields (SPEC 2.3): internal cost, margin, vendor quotes, vendor contracts and vendor invoices do not exist in this response (A-4, P-3). Contents to confirm after Q4.

nodes.label: CP-25 Invoice detail and payment
nodes.rationale: Only invoices with direction issued_to_client (GP-17). After Q4 Pay online is removed and bank-transfer instructions are shown.

nodes.label: CP-26 Vendor options
nodes.rationale: Board per category (Presented, Shortlisted, Selected, Declined). Vendor contact details, raw quotes, internal rating and notes absent; fewer than five options is normal and not labelled incomplete (SPEC 12).

nodes.label: CP-27 Vendor proposal detail
nodes.rationale: Approve, revise or decline a vendor proposal version; internal_cost absent; approved versions read-only; may await a second approver (1 of 2 decisions).

nodes.label: CP-29 Design item detail
nodes.rationale: Review a version with pinned comments (annotation_json) and decide; internal comments and the brief are absent (A-20); drafts not yet shared are unreachable.

nodes.label: CP-30 Invitations and save-the-dates
nodes.rationale: Approve invitation designs and watch distribution counts by channel; recipient-level delivery detail stays with the RSVP team in TW-41.

nodes.label: CP-31 Guest list
nodes.rationale: The family's guest list by household; internal notes, identity documents and RSVP tokens never appear; CV never reaches this screen. After Q7 it becomes a read-only summary with Ask the RSVP team; add, import and edit move to the staff side (import stays on TW-58).

nodes.label: CP-32 Household and guest detail
nodes.rationale: Read-only summary after Q7; identity documents, internal notes and tokens absent.

nodes.label: CP-33 RSVP progress
nodes.rationale: Counts per function and side; Viewers see numbers only, never names (permission-matrix 6).

nodes.label: CP-34 Menus
nodes.rationale: Approve menus per function; per-category headcounts and caterer guarantees are internal (data-model 14).

nodes.label: CP-35 Approvals inbox
nodes.rationale: Every decision waiting for the client in one place (PORTAL-FLOW Approvals); after Q5 either representative may approve.

nodes.label: CP-36 Requests
nodes.rationale: Questions, change requests and support in one typed, tracked place instead of chat (W-8, A-20, A-21). A change request to an approved item leads to a new version and a new approval, never an edit of the approved one (flow 6).

nodes.label: CP-37 Request detail
nodes.rationale: Thread and outcome of one request; staff internal comments never appear; impact_flags_json and budget_impact_amount are summarised in plain language, not exposed raw.

nodes.label: CP-38 Documents and schedules
nodes.rationale: Files with client visibility and downloadable schedules; share links are never offered because links are minted per download and expire in 15 minutes (T-7).

nodes.label: CP-39 Notifications and preferences
nodes.rationale: Notification list and per-event-type channel preferences including the WhatsApp opt-in consent (U-10, A-11).

nodes.label: CP-40 Feedback
nodes.rationale: Post-wedding feedback once per project after closure (A-24): rating, comments, consent to publish an excerpt.

nodes.label: CP-41 Closed project state
nodes.rationale: Banner making the read-only period explicit until client_access_until (A-23); requests limited to support; no edits, decisions or uploads. After Q23 names three months.

nodes.label: CP-42 Live chat
nodes.rationale: Added for AMPM's Q20 decision: immediate help from AMPM, distinct from tracked requests. A conversation never carries an approval or a budget figure; anything formal becomes a request via Turn this into a request. Conversations are scoped to the account and wedding; when no staff are online the composer says replies come by the preferred channel.

nodes.label: TW-01 Team dashboard
nodes.rationale: Cards appear only when the role has the underlying permission; role-specific alerts (new leads, expiring subscriptions, stale hotels, enquiry queue, unpaid milestones, failed notifications, incidents, readiness blocked). Finance uses dashboard cards rather than a separate workspace.

nodes.label: TW-02 Calendar
nodes.rationale: Functions, site visits, task due dates, milestones and staff shifts in one calendar with a signed ICS feed (GP-28).

nodes.label: TW-10 Lead pipeline
nodes.rationale: Board by lead status (new, contacted, introduction shared, demo offered, demo accessed, follow up, converted, closed); drag only where permission-matrix 7 allows.

nodes.label: TW-11 Lead detail
nodes.rationale: Consultation and questionnaire are lead activity types (W-12); Grant demo creates the demo account, user and subscription; Convert creates the client account. No account is created without Convert (WHY 4); duplicate merge is audited.

nodes.label: TW-13 Account detail
nodes.rationale: Commercial and access hub for one client; Billing (RESTRICTED-BANK) and Notes (RESTRICTED-NOTES) tabs render only for permitted roles.

nodes.label: TW-14 Subscription detail
nodes.rationale: Manage one subscription through its statuses; activation never happens without a succeeded payment row except trials (SPEC 8).

nodes.label: TW-15 Service agreement editor
nodes.rationale: Scope, fees, terms and payment stages for any paid service (GP-5, GP-6); fee values are entered, never defaulted from code (BIZ rule 8); Send makes it appear in CP-11 or CP-09.

nodes.label: TW-21 Hotels list
nodes.rationale: The private hotel database (BIZ 2.A: never public) with freshness filters and bulk demo visibility.

nodes.label: TW-22 Hotel profile editor
nodes.rationale: Verification per field group with next due; Preview as client renders CP-05 through the client serialiser and is the only way to see what clients see (architecture 6); media without rights cannot be set client or public (GP-20).

nodes.label: TW-23 Rate card editor
nodes.rationale: A card cannot be verified without a verification record; stale is set by the job, not by hand (GP-8, A-9).

nodes.label: TW-24 Verification queue
nodes.rationale: What needs re-checking by due date (SPEC 8 stale rule).

nodes.label: TW-25 Hotel import
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheet import of hotels, rooms, venues and rates (GP-22, RK-1); imported rates are unverified until a verification row exists.

nodes.label: TW-26 Enquiry queue
nodes.rationale: Chargeable services without an agreement are flagged (U-3).

nodes.label: TW-27 Enquiry detail
nodes.rationale: Runs an enquiry end to end while keeping internal work internal (SPEC 12): the composer's internal-only toggle defaults on for negotiation notes, the internal badge is unmistakable, and Preview as client (CP-09) proves what the client sees. Confirmed status needs a done confirmed milestone and a signed contract.

nodes.label: TW-28 Hotel proposal editor
nodes.rationale: Separate client and internal totals (A-4): client total computed from visible lines, internal panel (internal total, commission basis, margin) RESTRICTED-FINANCE and never shown in Preview as client; shared versions immutable.

nodes.label: TW-31 Create project wizard
nodes.rationale: Creates the wedding record with the minimum mandatory fields (only name, account, dates and lead; SPEC 5, BIZ rule 2, U-6); back-fills saved hotels, enquiries and agreements and creates checklists.

nodes.label: TW-32 Project dashboard
nodes.rationale: Single source of truth per wedding; internal finance panel only for FA, SA, PM (a); status transitions guarded by permission-matrix 7; the header becomes a live banner when live.

nodes.label: TW-33 Project settings and members
nodes.rationale: Facts, membership, client access window after closure, and the guest-data switches: identity capture enabled with purpose text, travel information requested (yes, no, by tier).

nodes.label: TW-34 Functions list and editor
nodes.rationale: Readiness is derived and read-only here (A-26).

nodes.label: TW-36 Budget workbook
nodes.rationale: Estimate, approvals, commitments, actuals, internal cost and variance in one grid; internal columns are omitted from the response for roles without the finance class (W-5); approved amounts are locked and change only through a change request (flow 6); a material change beyond the threshold triggers a change-request suggestion (A-25).

nodes.label: TW-38 Vendor assignments for a project
nodes.rationale: Present options with an availability check for the function dates; record client decisions on behalf with evidence (P-9); fewer than five options never blocks presenting (SPEC 12).

nodes.label: TW-39 Vendor proposal editor
nodes.rationale: Client and internal amounts separated (A-4); internal panel with internal cost, margin and linked raw quotes RESTRICTED-FINANCE; shared versions immutable; Preview as client renders CP-27.

nodes.label: TW-40 Design items and versions
nodes.rationale: Internal review thread defaults to internal; clients see only shared versions and client-visible items (A-20).

nodes.label: TW-41 Invitations editor and distribution
nodes.rationale: Sending requires an approved version and WhatsApp opt-in for recipients (U-10); channel templates come from TW-94; failures create follow-up tasks.

nodes.label: TW-42 Client requests queue and detail
nodes.rationale: Handles questions, change requests and support with budget impact amount and impact flags that create review tasks automatically for material requests (A-20, A-21, A-25).

nodes.label: TW-43 Approvals tracker
nodes.rationale: Every approval in a project and its age (SPEC 9); Remind; Record decision on behalf with evidence (P-9).

nodes.label: TW-44 Documents
nodes.rationale: All project files with visibility control and revocable access links; identity documents never appear here (separate gated panel in TW-51).

nodes.label: TW-45 Closure checklist and final accounts
nodes.rationale: Closes a wedding with evidence (SPEC 7, 12): each checklist item has a live data check; Close is enabled only when complete or complete with an authorised exception and final accounts approved. After Q10 Authorise exception is Super Admin only; after Q23 Archive is a Super Admin approval after the access window.

nodes.label: TW-50 Guest database
nodes.rationale: Sensitive and identity fields never in the grid or export (P-10).

nodes.label: TW-51 Household and guest editor
nodes.rationale: Full household record with sensitive (SENSITIVE-GUEST) and identity panels gated separately (P-4, P-5): the identity panel is absent without the grant, viewing writes an audit event and alerts; assisted responses write an rsvp_responses snapshot with captured_by. After Q8 the identity panel shows retained until AMPM approves deletion.

nodes.label: TW-52 Attendance board
nodes.rationale: Attendance per function with inline assisted changes (source ampm_call) and a recalculation notice when headcounts update (SPEC 12 duplicates test).

nodes.label: TW-53 RSVP call list
nodes.rationale: Chase non-responders after reminders (U-5); logging a call outcome opens the TW-51 attendance grid.

nodes.label: TW-54 Tokens and distribution status
nodes.rationale: Per-household link status, delivery, resend, revoke and reissue (A-7, P-4).

nodes.label: TW-55 Rooming
nodes.rationale: Room blocks (internal rate RESTRICTED-FINANCE), allocations grid, check-in with gated identity indicator, check-out confirming departure; every allocation change audited (SPEC 7).

nodes.label: TW-56 Travel and transport
nodes.rationale: Travel segments, vehicles (driver phone RESTRICTED-CONTACT), transfers with seat validation, manifests exported without identity data; arrival lists offline-capable after Q1.

nodes.label: TW-58 Guest import
nodes.rationale: Spreadsheet import into households and guests (GP-22); duplicates by phone or email within the project are flagged, never auto-merged.

nodes.label: TW-61 Vendor profile editor
nodes.rationale: Client-facing and internal parts separated: contacts RESTRICTED-CONTACT, rating and notes RESTRICTED-NOTES, bank details RESTRICTED-BANK; Preview as client shows the option card.

nodes.label: TW-62 Vendor quotes
nodes.rationale: Raw quotes received from vendors, internal only (A-4); RESTRICTED-FINANCE table never previewed to clients.

nodes.label: TW-64 Artists and production
nodes.rationale: Performers, riders and production items per function; internal fee RESTRICTED-FINANCE.

nodes.label: TW-70 Tasks
nodes.rationale: Accountability for everything (SPEC 3); blocked needs a reason; offline-capable after Q1.

nodes.label: TW-72 Staffing roster
nodes.rationale: Who is on site, when, in which role (GP-30); overlap warnings; publishing notifies.

nodes.label: TW-73 Run-of-show editor and live view
nodes.rationale: Internal cue sheet and its execution; never client-visible; offline the cached cues stay readable, actions queue and a banner counts queued updates (T-11, U-7).

nodes.label: TW-74 Readiness board
nodes.rationale: Required checks per function with a go-live gate explaining what blocks; readiness cannot complete without checks or an authorised exception (SPEC 7, 12, P-8). After Q10 Authorise exception is Super Admin only; the Project Manager sees Request exception.

nodes.label: TW-75 Incidents
nodes.rationale: Report, assign, escalate and resolve; critical unassigned incidents past the configured minutes escalate automatically; client-visible toggle off by default.

nodes.label: TW-76 Event-day console
nodes.rationale: One screen for the wedding day: functions with readiness and live status, current cues, arrivals and transfers in the next hour, incidents, staff on duty, sync indicator (T-11, T-14).

nodes.label: TW-80 Payments ledger
nodes.rationale: Inbound and outbound money with gateway reconciliation; outbound rows RESTRICTED-FINANCE (GP-17).

nodes.label: TW-81 Invoices
nodes.rationale: Issue client invoices with GST fields and record received vendor or hotel invoices (GP-17, GP-18, A-16).

nodes.label: TW-83 Reports hub
nodes.rationale: The SPEC 9 reports with permission-filtered exports: exports always strip sensitive, identity, bank and secret classes and finance classes unless permitted (P-10); every export is audited.

nodes.label: TW-84 Final accounts
nodes.rationale: Reconcile and approve a wedding's accounts before closure; closing statement PDF carries client-facing totals only.

nodes.label: TW-90 Users and roles
nodes.rationale: Staff accounts and roles; client logins are managed in TW-13 (A-13).

nodes.label: TW-91 Roles and permissions viewer
nodes.rationale: The effective matrix (permission-matrix.md as data); SA edits non-system keys.

nodes.label: TW-92 Plans and packages
nodes.rationale: Configurable commercial plans, modules, demo plan, terms version (SPEC 10, A-3).

nodes.label: TW-93 Reference data
nodes.rationale: Lead sources, service types, function types, budget categories, vendor categories, checklist templates, questionnaire template, status display labels.

nodes.label: TW-94 Notification templates and channels
nodes.rationale: Templates per event and channel with provider identifiers (WhatsApp approved template, SMS DLT template); channel enablement; test send (A-11).

nodes.label: TW-95 Configuration
nodes.rationale: Thresholds and rules: verification age, material-change thresholds, escalation chain, reminder cadence, retention periods, client access window, demo reset schedule, upload limits, identity capture default. After Q8/Q17 gains a Retention proposals tab where the Super Admin approves deletions proposed by the retention job.

nodes.label: TW-96 Audit log
nodes.rationale: Search the append-only history with before and after (secrets masked); SA all, FA finance entities, PM (a) own projects.

nodes.label: TW-97 Public content (dropped by AMPM, Q12)
nodes.rationale: Would have edited website pages and showcase items (A-12); AMPM decided on 25 Oct 2026 that staff will not edit website content through the app, so it is not built and kept for reference only.

nodes.label: TW-98 Chat console
nodes.rationale: Staff side of live chat added for Q20: queue with waiting time and assignee, canned replies, Turn into a request; unassigned conversations older than the configured minutes are highlighted to the department lead; internal notes go in comments with is_internal, never in the thread.

nodes.label: GR-01 Invitation landing
nodes.rationale: Exchanges the token for a guest session and records consent and notice version; nothing is shown before the token is validated and no other household is ever named. After Q7 it becomes the per-side link with household self-identification.

nodes.label: GR-02 Confirm your household
nodes.rationale: Add a member only while the household's allowance remains, capped server-side (A-7); when exhausted the add button is absent, not disabled; members cannot be removed but can be marked not attending.

nodes.label: GR-03 Attendance
nodes.rationale: Attendance per member per invited function with Attending, Not attending, Maybe; tentative is stored as tentative, never as attending (data-model 12).

nodes.label: GR-04 Meals and needs
nodes.rationale: Dietary preference required for attending members (BIZ rule 7); allergies and accessibility needs are SENSITIVE-GUEST and never shown back outside the permitted classes (GP-24).

nodes.label: GR-05 Travel and accommodation
nodes.rationale: Skipped entirely when the project does not request travel information (TW-33 setting); identity document block only when enabled, with purpose text and retention statement; Aadhaar numbers are refused on upload (A-8, GP-41); files go to the restricted bucket and the guest sees only received.

nodes.label: GR-06 Review and submit
nodes.rationale: Writes attendance, guests, travel segments and the rsvp_responses payload in one atomic transaction (flow 7); submit is idempotent per token and draft version; a failure keeps the draft.

nodes.label: GR-07 Confirmation
nodes.rationale: Attendance summary, hospitality contact, calendar file. After Q7 loses Update your response and gains Request a correction (GR-09, type correction).

nodes.label: GR-08 Link unavailable
nodes.rationale: Explains an expired, revoked or unknown link without revealing data (P-4): no wedding, household or guest data beyond the project name for expired links; a small form creates a reissue task for the RSVP team.

nodes.label: GR-09 Support request
nodes.rationale: Guest help with travel, rooms, meals or access needs; dietary, accessibility and complaint types are treated as sensitive on the staff side.
